THE CLAUSE

A system or developer message will list the available tools, where each one includes some documentation of its functionality and what syntax should be used in a message to that tool.

  [concepts[3]] «the listing of tool T in message M includes documentation of T's functionality»
  [concepts[4]] «the listing of tool T in message M includes documentation of the syntax to use in a message to T»
